{{Quote|Too steep for me.|The bald man folds his hand in response to Lando Calrissian's sabacc bluff|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
A '''bald''' [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] once played a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with five other players, including [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], in the [[Flip of the Credit]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. The bald man folded one of his hands in response to Calrissian's bold play, not realizing Calrissian was bluffing.
